We process orders within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next business day.

Buyavsdeals is owned and operated by AllRoundFix LLC, a company committed to delivering reliable products, transparent pricing, and a secure online shopping experience.

Shipping Methods & Delivery Times:

  • Standard Shipping: 3–7 business days
  • Express Shipping (if available): 1–3 business days
  • Delivery times may vary due to location, carrier delays, or unforeseen circumstances.

Shipping Charges:

  • Shipping fees are calculated at checkout.
  • Free shipping may be available on qualifying orders or promotions.

Order Tracking & Delivery Issues:

  • A tracking number will be sent once your order ships.
  • For damaged, defective, or missing items, contact us within 48 hours of delivery.
  • Packages returned due to incorrect address or refusal to accept may incur additional shipping charges.

Delivery Locations:

  • We ship to all serviceable addresses in [Country/Region].
  • P.O. Boxes and international addresses are not supported unless stated at checkout.

Lost Shipments:

  • If your package is lost in transit, we will coordinate with the courier to resolve it.
  • Replacement or refund will follow our Refund & Returns Policy.

Contact Us:

  • Phone No : +1-(857)-323-0164
  • Email: support@buyavsdeals.online
  • Address:670 River St, Hyde Park, MA 02136, United States
